title: Running
info: Start when the signal says go, not before.
Look ahead, swing your arms, and keep going to the finish line.
After you finish, walk and drink water. Comparing yourself kindly to your own last time is a good goal.

options: Catch a cricket ball in a sprint
You must stop and sit on the track forever

questions.q: After a hard run you should

options: Your own fastest or farthest so far
